footer.tagline: Evidence-informed, AI-assisted support for mothers during pregnancy and the first year after birth.
footer.disclaimer: MumWell supports but does not replace professional care. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.
footer.noTracking: No advertising or tracking cookies. Privacy protected to GDPR standards.
footer.crisisBody: If you or your baby are in danger, call your local emergency number or find a helpline for your country.

ai.disclosure: You are talking to an AI, not a human. It can make mistakes and does not replace professional care.

crisis.compactTitle: You don't have to go through this alone.
crisis.compactBody: If you are thinking about harming yourself or your baby, or you feel unsafe, call your local emergency number now or reach out to someone you trust nearby.
crisis.title: Need help right now?
crisis.intro: If you are in immediate danger, or thinking about harming yourself or your baby, contact emergency services or a crisis line now. Postpartum depression is common and treatable, and reaching out is a sign of strength.
crisis.supportNote: 116 123 is available in many European countries.
crisis.elsewhere: Somewhere else? Find a free, confidential helpline at
crisis.noLocalHelplines: We don't have helpline numbers for your country yet. Please call your local emergency number, or choose a nearby country below.
crisis.directoryIntro: If you or your baby are in immediate danger, call the emergency number for the country you are in right now. Tap a number to call.

consentGate.title: Before you continue
consentGate.body: We've updated how we keep you safe: if you appear to be at immediate risk, MumWell can now alert a crisis helpline so someone can contact you. Please review and confirm the points below to continue.

consent.terms: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
consent.health: I explicitly consent to MumWell processing information about my health and wellbeing (such as mood, screening results and conversations) to provide the service. I can withdraw this consent at any time by deleting my account. If I appear to be at immediate risk of harming myself or my baby, MumWell may share my contact details and the message that raised concern with its crisis helpline so that a trained person can reach me.
consent.required: Please confirm all three points to continue.

supportBar.text: In crisis or worried about your safety? Call your local emergency number.
